newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine harvest, almost over, at 21.27 million T.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine harvest, almost over, at 21.27 million T.

text.p: Ukraine's grain harvest, excluding maize, is nearly over, and stands at 21.274 million tonnes gross weight, the Statistics Ministry said on Wednesday.
The Agriculture Ministry said the country had just started its maize (corn) harvest, which may yield two million tonnes.
In addition, it said, private farmers, whose output is not included in the Statistics Ministry figure, may produce one to two million tonnes of all grains.

The Agriculture Ministry said the winter wheat harvest was nearly over and stood at about 13.15 million tonnes, against 16.4 million tonnes in 1995. It did not say whether the first figure referred to net or to gross weight.
Overall average grain crop yields were lower at 2.09 tonnes per hectare, compared to 2.58 tonnes at this time last year.

But some officials and analysts have said said privately that Ukraine's total grain harvest could reach only 26 million tonnes or even less.
